;Armed conflicts and attacks
*[[Saudi Arabian-led intervention in Yemen]], [[COVID-19 pandemic in Yemen]]
**The Saudi-led coalition announces the extension of a unilateral ceasefire by one month to fight the pandemic. The [[Houthi movement|Houthis]] did not accept the coalition's previous ceasefire that expired Thursday. Reportedly, the Houthis "want a lifting of air and sea blockades imposed by the coalition to the regions they control before agreeing to a ceasefire". [https://www.reuters.com/article/us-yemen-security-saudi/saudi-led-coalition-announces-one-month-extension-of-yemen-ceasefire-idUSKCN2261GS (Reuters)]
*[[Internal conflict in Myanmar]]
**Unknown gunmen attack the headquarters of the [[government of Myanmar|government]]-backed Pan Say [[militia]] in [[Muse, Myanmar|Muse]], [[Shan State]]. The attackers opened fire with [[small arms]] and [[artillery]] before fleeing in cars and motorbikes. No group has claimed responsibility for the attack. [https://www.irrawaddy.com/news/burma/gunmen-attack-govt-militia-china-myanmar-border.html (''The Irrawaddy'')]
*[[Kivu conflict]]
**An attack by members of the [[Democratic Forces for the Liberation of Rwanda]] in [[Virunga National Park]], [[Democratic Republic of the Congo]], leaves 17 people dead: 12 park rangers and five civilians. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2020/04/drc-rangers-civilians-killed-attack-virunga-national-park-200424161459752.html (Al Jazeera)]  

;Business and economy
*[[COVID-19 pandemic in Indonesia]]
**The [[Government of Indonesia|government]] bans vehicles from entering or leaving the [[Jakarta metropolitan area]] to prevent [[Mudik]], a local observance in which migrants and migrant workers return home for [[Ramadan]]. [https://www.thejakartapost.com/news/2020/04/23/govt-temporarily-bans-passenger-travel-to-prevent-mudik.html (''The Jakarta Post'')]
*[[Economic impact of the COVID-19 pandemic in the United States]]
**[[President of the United States|President]] [[Donald Trump]] signs a {{USD|484}}{{nbsp}}billion interim coronavirus relief bill that will add another $310 billion to the small-business [[Paycheck Protection Program]], as well as provide billions in aid to hospitals and for testing. [https://www.axios.com/trump-signs-interim-coronavirus-relief-bill-192d7b83-ec92-4fa9-9f8c-be241e886192.html (Axios)]

;Health and environment
*[[COVID-19 pandemic in the United States]]
**More than 50,000 people have now died in the [[United States]] from [[Coronavirus disease 2019|COVID-19]], according to data from [[Johns Hopkins University]]. [https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/world-us-canada-52415579 (BBC News)]

;Law and crime
*[[Saudi Arabia]] says it will end flogging as a form of punishment, according to a [[government of Saudi Arabia|government]] document. [https://www.reuters.com/article/us-saudi-rights-flogging/saudi-arabia-to-end-flogging-as-form-of-punishment-document-idUSKCN2262VT?il=0 (Reuters)]
*Six activists of the [[Free Papua Movement]] are sentenced by an [[Judiciary of Indonesia|Indonesian court]] to 8–9 months in prison for treason. The ruling is condemned by [[Amnesty International]] and [[Human Rights Watch]] as a violation of their [[freedom of speech]] and [[Freedom of assembly|assembly]]. [https://www.reuters.com/article/us-indonesia-papua-treason/indonesia-convicts-papua-activists-of-treason-for-holding-protest-idUSKCN2270CN?il=0 (Reuters)]

;Politics and elections
*[[Ministry of Justice and Public Security (Brazil)|Brazilian Minister of Justice]] [[Sérgio Moro]] resigns, claiming [[President of Brazil|President]] [[Jair Bolsonaro]] is criminally interfering with the country's [[Law enforcement in Brazil|law enforcement]]. [https://www.reuters.com/article/us-brazil-politics/brazil-justice-minister-quits-accuses-bolsonaro-of-meddling-in-police-idUSKCN2261KW?il=0 (Reuters)]
